name: ridgeline
desc_en: On empty paper, ink lines draw the photograph's own edges, the ridge of Aoraki, the horizon, the frame of the car window; then the paper splits along the drawn ridge, sky half up and land half down, and the lines turn out to have been the photograph all along, which fills the window.
desc_zh: 空白紙面上，墨線先描出這張照片自己的輪廓：奧拉基的稜線、地平線、車窗的邊框；接著紙面沿著剛畫好的稜線裂開，天空那半往上、大地那半往下，才發現線條原本就是這張照片，照片隨即佔滿整個視窗。
borrowed: The move from cold abstraction to perceived reality: lines on a flat ground that turn out, when the ground gives way, to have been the geometry of the photograph underneath all along.
